title: A modular-storage proof of NP-completeness for chip-firing halting on simple digraphs
accepted_scope: Halting conservative chip-firing on finite loopless simple strongly connected digraphs with nonnegative binary chips is NP-complete; 3-SAT reduction has polynomial total chips and root deletion depth≤1 DAG. Separate appendix proves oriented no-antiparallel version.
limitations: No original simple-directed-halting gap asserted; unary chip encoding also hard because polynomial chips. Membership credited to Farrell–Levine. No Eulerian-multigraph halting conclusion or conflation with 3000016 reachability.
